instagram_log.hook: What does a whole valley smell like?
instagram_log.caption:
Episode 1 of From Antalya to Your Stove 🍊 Dawn in our family orchard in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast. Every winter the whole valley smells like oranges and spice, and that is the smell we send you. We slice and dry our oranges in the sun, my uncle's spice shop in Eminonu supplies the cinnamon, cloves and star anise, and we blend and pack every kraft pouch by hand in Istanbul. Simmer one on your stove and your home fills with a little of that valley. Gifting a crowd? Our kits are bulk-friendly: minimum 12 pouches, with personalized labels for teachers, coworkers, clients or hostesses. Tap the link in our bio to order 🎄
